sources.title: Gemma 3: The Most Powerful AI Model You Can Run on One GPU
sources.snippet: Built on the same research that powers the Gemini 2.0 models, Gemma 3 is our most advanced, portable, and responsibly developed open model collection yet. Available in various sizes (1B, 4B, 12B, and 27B), it provides developers the flexibility to select the best option for their hardware and performance requirements.
